import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List

VERSION_FILE = Path(\"fastapi/__init__.py\")
RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = Path(\"docs/en/docs/release-notes.md\")

def bump_version(new_version: str) -> None:
    \"\"\"Update the version in fastapi/__init__.py.\"\"\"
    content = VERSION_FILE.read_text()
    new_content = re.sub(r\"__version__ = \".*?\", f\"__version__ = \"{new_version}\"\", content)
    VERSION_FILE.write_text(new_content)
    print(f\"Updated version to {new_version} in {VERSION_FILE}\")

def update_release_notes(new_version: str) -> None:
    \"\"\"Move content from 'Latest Changes' to a new version section in release notes.\"\"\"
    lines = RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.read_text().splitlines()
    
    latest_changes_index = -1
    next_header_index = -1
    
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.strip() == \"## Latest Changes\":
            latest_changes_index = i
        elif latest_changes_index != -1 and line.startswith(\"## \"):
            next_header_index = i
            break
            
    if latest_changes_index == -1:
        print(\"Could not find '## Latest Changes' section in release notes.\")
        sys.exit(1)
        
    if next_header_index == -1:
        # If there are no other version headers, we take everything until the end
        next_header_index = len(lines)
        
    # Extract content of Latest Changes
    latest_changes_content = lines[latest_changes_index + 1 : next_header_index]
    
    # Filter out empty lines at the beginning and end of the content
    while latest_changes_content and not latest_changes_content[0].strip():
        latest_changes_content.pop(0)
    while latest_changes_content and not latest_changes_content[-1].strip():
        latest_changes_content.pop()
        
    if not latest_changes_content:
        print(\"No content found in 'Latest Changes' section. Nothing to move.\")
        return

    # Construct new lines
    new_lines = lines[: latest_changes_index + 1]
    new_lines.append(\"\") # Ensure empty line after ## Latest Changes
    new_lines.append(f\"## {new_version}\")
    new_lines.append(\"\") # Ensure empty line after version header
    new_lines.extend(latest_changes_content)
    new_lines.append(\"\") # Ensure empty line after content
    new_lines.extend(lines[next_header_index:])
    
    RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.write_text(\"\\n\".join(new_lines) + \"\\n\")
    print(f\"Moved Latest Changes to version {new_version} in {RELEASE_NOTES_FILE}\")

def main() -> None:
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        print(\"Usage: python scripts/release.py <new_version>\")
        sys.exit(1)
        
    new_version = sys.argv[1]
    bump_version(new_version)
    update_release_notes(new_version)
    print(\"Release preparation complete!\")

if __name__ == \"__main__\":
    main()

+"""Automate release preparation: bump version and update release notes."""

+import re

+RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+
+def bump_version(new_version: str) -> None:
+    """Update the version in fastapi/__init__.py."""
+    content = VERSION_FILE.read_text()
+    new_content = re.sub(r"__version__ = \".*?\"", f'__version__ = "{new_version}"', content)
+    VERSION_FILE.write_text(new_content)
+    print(f"Updated version to {new_version} in {VERSION_FILE}")
+
+def update_release_notes(new_version: str) -> None:
+    """Move content from 'Latest Changes' to a new version section in release notes."""
+    lines = RELEASE_NOTES_FILE.read_text().splitlines()
+    
+    latest_changes_index = -1
+    next_header_index = -1
+    
+    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
+        if line.strip() == "## Latest Changes":
+            latest_changes_index = i
+        elif latest_changes_index != -1 and line.startswith("## "):
+            next_header_index = i
+            break
+            
+    if latest_changes_index == -1:
+        print("Could not find '## Latest Changes' section in release notes.")
+        sys.exit(1)
+        
+    if next_header_index == -1:
+        # If there are no other version headers, we take everything until the end
+        next_header_index = len(lines)
+        
+    # Extract content of Latest Changes
+    latest_changes_content = lines[latest_changes_index + 1 : next_header_index]
+    
+    # Filter out empty lines at the beginning and end of the content
+    while latest_changes_content and not latest_changes_content[0].strip():
+        latest_changes_content.pop(0)
+    while latest_changes_content and not latest_changes_content[-1].strip():
+        latest_changes_content.pop()
+        
+    if not latest_changes_content:
+        print("No content found in 'Latest Changes' section. Nothing to move.")
+        return
+
+    # Construct new lines
+    new_lines = lines[: latest_changes_index + 1]
+    new_lines.append("") # Ensure empty line after ## Latest Changes
+    new_lines.append(f"## {new_version}")
+    new_lines.append("") # Ensure empty line after version header
+    new_lines.extend(latest_changes_content)
+    new_lines.append("") # Ensure empty line after content
+    new_lines.extend(lines[next_header_index:])
+
